tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file inside the agent workspace or skill drafts.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write a UTF-8 text file under workspace/ or skills/drafts/ only.

tools.name: list_dir
tools.description: List files in a directory under the agent root.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the public web. Returns titles, urls, snippets. Offline stub if no key.

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Fetch a public HTTP URL and return truncated text.

tools.name: run_python
tools.description: Run a short Python snippet in a subprocess with timeout and no extra env.

tools.name: run_skill
tools.description: Execute an approved (or explicitly drafted) skill by name.

tools.name: init_project
tools.description: Start a new CreatorCentral project at axiom 1 (INITIATION).

tools.name: project_status
tools.description: Show a CreatorCentral project's current axiom, evidence, and log; or list all projects.

tools.name: check_axiom
tools.description: Read-only: which requirements of the project's current axiom are met vs missing.

tools.name: advance_axiom
tools.description: Gate: move a CreatorCentral project to the next axiom, refusing if requirements are missing.

tools.name: log_evidence
tools.description: Attach evidence text to one requirement of a CreatorCentral project's current axiom.

tools.name: close_project
tools.description: Close a CreatorCentral project. Honest: records done only if it reached REST, else closed_early.
